trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production. After the rollback, all three regions are on v2.3.0 and reporting healthy, with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. My first request to open it timed out. I checked the incident list, confirmed nothing had been created, then retried with the same idempotency key, so there's only one incident.
- **Worth a look:** The test version of v2.3.1 (v2.3.1-rc) was already failing in staging before it reached production. I noted this in the incident so the follow-up covers why it was released anyway, as well as what broke.
